invented_facts: Aurora is described as “future-proof,” which the brief does not establish.
“Leading AI performance” and “outperforming” Vantage imply measured performance beyond the NPU specifications provided.
The claim that Aurora meets “typical mobile work requirements” is not supported by the video-playback battery rating.
The discovery question assumes the customer's team has growing use of local AI models.
notes: The battlecard includes every requested section, stays under 350 words, and fairly acknowledges Vantage's advantages. Several claims and customer assumptions need tightening before it is ready to send.
